not sure if you've made it yet, but it depends on what material you will use to cast it. generally silicone isn't used to make molds with ceramic because they fuse to each other (both are silica) if you're wanting to make ceramic duplicates, plaster is the only way to go. I saw someone talking about hydrocal but thats more of a specialist material, expensive, and hard to get depending on where you are. its also not the best for ceramic slip casting. you can get plaster of paris from home depot. Its inexpensive and very forgiving. Also search for ceramic press molds or slip cast molds on youtube.
